BDI.note: Notice is about the e-Gov portal; nothing on a business register.

systems.owner: PAFEN / SETIC, Ministry of Finance, Budget and the Digital Economy

BDI.note: Request for proposals to build the portal issued 2026-10-20 with bids due 2026-12-04; no portal launched or piloted.

facts.fact: The PAFEN request for proposals requires the e-Gov portal to interoperate with government platforms and registers in line with Burundi's 'Cadre national d'interopérabilité'.
